description: Acknowledge a host or service problem, as the user asking: someone knows and works on it, so it stops notifying until it recovers. The author is the user. Waits until the engine shows it. Only for a problem that exists now and is not acknowledged yet.

comment.description: What is known and who works on it, e.g. a ticket number.

hostname.description: Exact host name. Required - there is no estate-wide form of this tool. A name that matches no host is answered with the tools that can find the right one.

notify.description: Tell the contacts that the problem is acknowledged.

servicename.description: Exact service name on that host. Empty: acknowledge the host.

sticky.description: Keep the acknowledgement until the object is ok again, also when the problem changes state.

with_services.description: For a host: also acknowledge the problems of its services.

name: acknowledge_problem
title: Acknowledge Problem
